# drizzle

SQL migrations generated by drizzle-kit from `src/db/schema.ts` (config in `drizzle.config.ts`). Applied in order by `bun run db:migrate`.

## Files
| File | What it's for |
|---|---|
| `0000_lumpy_the_spike.sql` | `daily_prices`, `daily_indicators` (close, sma_50, sma_200, ema_200), `index_members`, `ingest_log`; index on `daily_prices(symbol, trade_date)` |
| `0001_sticky_hercules.sql` | `corporate_actions` (PK symbol + ex_date + subject), index on `ex_date` |
| `0002_perfect_talkback.sql` | `symbol_changes` (PK old + new + changed_on), index on `new_symbol` |
| `0003_cultured_the_executioner.sql` | `index_prices` (PK trade_date + index_name) |
| `0004`–`0006` | Add `change_pct`, `vol_ratio`, `turnover` to `daily_indicators` |
| `0007_shiny_miek.sql` | Index `daily_indicators(symbol, trade_date)` (decision 0021) |
| `0008_cute_turbo.sql` | `daily_delivery` (PK trade_date + symbol + series; traded and deliverable qty, bigint) |
| `0009_third_banshee.sql` | `unusual_days` (PK trade_date + symbol; four kind flags and their ratios) for `/activity` |
| `0010_parallel_mephisto.sql` | `fund_symbols` (symbol, first_seen): ETFs seen in bhavcopy (ISIN "INF…") since the committed list, topped up nightly so they stay out of Unusual activity and Top volume |
| `0011_misty_wildside.sql` | `index_constituents` (PK index_key + symbol; industry, fetched_on) for Top volume |
| `0012_young_tinkerer.sql` | `volume_leaders` (PK symbol + period; turnover, shares, sessions, unusual_days) for `/volume` |

`meta/` (journal and snapshots) is written by drizzle-kit and deliberately not documented here.

## Rules here
- Never hand-write or edit a migration: change `src/db/schema.ts`, then `bun run db:generate && bun run db:migrate` (root CLAUDE.md, Commands).
- Migrate the test database too: `DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/tradesence_test bun run db:migrate` (README setup); `bun test` does not migrate it.
- Every price/indicator column is `double precision`, volume and delivery quantities `bigint`, dates `date`; keep new columns consistent.
